creative_direction: Create a graphic portrait of Ran Mouri tucking a small section of her long dark hair behind one ear. Preserve the familiar front hair shape and youthful face, with both eyes unobstructed. She wears a plain navy cardigan over an ivory top with a modest neckline. Her torso turns slightly away while the face returns toward the viewer, with a gentle closed-mouth smile. Use mint, slate, and warm cream color blocks, keeping the hair as a few clear interlocking shapes. The hand stays compact near the ear, and the background contains no room details or decorative text. Use gentle rose-violet concentric iris rings around clear dark pupils, with bright catchlights. A pale moon disc sits behind the portrait as a quiet background shape, suggesting Infinite Tsukuyomi without changing the expression. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
